messages.content: What's project is "Adriel" working on? exclude any that are completed?

function.name: get_adriel_projects
function.description: Retrieve a list of projects that are associated with Adriel, including their current status and estimated completion dates. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user Adriel.

include_completed.description: A flag to determine whether to include completed projects in the list.

status_filter.description: Filter projects by status, such as 'active', 'paused', or 'completed'.

function.name: get_detail_adriel_projects
function.description: Retrieve detailed information about projects that Adriel is or has been involved in, including project status and participation role. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

project_name.description: The unique name of the project for which details are to be fetched.

include_archived.description: A flag to determine whether to include projects that are archived. Defaults to false.

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "What's project is 'Adriel' working on? exclude any that are completed?" They want to know what project(s) Adriel is currently working on, excluding completed ones. We need to call get_adriel_projects with user_id (we don't have it; we might need to ask for it). But maybe we can assume we have some user ID? The prompt says "Retrieve a list of projects that are associated with Adriel, including their current status and estimated completion dates." So we should call get_adriel_projects with user_id. But we don't have user_id. We could ask the user for the user_id. Or we could guess it's something like "adriel123". But better to ask.

We also need to filter out completed projects. The function get_adriel_projects has parameters: user_id, include_completed (default false), status_filter (default active). If we set status_filter to "active", we will only get active projects. That excludes paused and completed. But if we want to exclude completed but include paused? The question: "exclude any that are completed?" It doesn't say exclude paused. So we might want to include both active and paused. But the function's status_filter only allows one value. So we can't specify multiple statuses. But we can call twice: once for active, once for paused. Or we can just use status_filter="active" to get active ones. But the user didn't specify they want paused too. They said "exclude any that are completed". That implies include all non-completed, i.e., active and paused. But the function cannot do that directly. We could call get_adriel_projects twice: once with status_filter="active", once with status_filter="paused". Then combine results. Or we could call get_adriel_projects with include_completed=false and status_filter unspecified (defaults to active). That would give us active only. But we might miss paused. But the user didn't explicitly request paused. They just said exclude completed. I'd interpret that as include active and paused. So we should call twice.

But we still need user_id. Let's ask the user for the user_id.
